name: saas-landing
title: Leo's starter: SaaS landing page
description: A landing page you can sell from: hero with a 3D signal field, features, how it works, pricing with a monthly and yearly toggle, testimonials, FAQ and a working waitlist. All copy lives in one config file.
features: Working waitlist: POST /api/waitlist with validation, honeypot and rate limiting
Signups saved to data/waitlist.json, optional webhook forwarding via WAITLIST_WEBHOOK_URL
All copy, pricing and links in src/config/site.ts
Light and dark theme with no flash, follows the system by default
Lazy loaded three.js hero that reacts to pointer and scroll, pauses off screen, static fallback
GSAP hero intro, scroll driven reveals and an animated pricing toggle
Metadata, generated Open Graph image, sitemap.xml and robots.txt

demo.try: Enter an email in the hero form and press Join the waitlist. The signup appears in data/waitlist.json.
